summary_1line: Bharata gathers a vast army and citizens of Ayodhya and marches to the Ganges at Shringaverapur, hoping to bring Rama back from exile.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bharata’s grand chariot leads a massive procession of elephants, chariots, and citizens streaming out of Ayodhya at dawn to seek Rama.
Thousands of people from every trade and caste travel together in carts and on elephants, joyfully speaking of Rama as they journey through the countryside.
The immense army halts at the wide, shimmering Ganges near Shringaverapur while Bharata surveys his gathered forces on the riverbank.
